**Medi-Cal** is California’s Medicaid program, providing free or low-cost health coverage to eligible low-income residents.[1][4]

If you meant something more specific—such as **eligibility**, **benefits**, **how to apply**, or **provider billing**—I can help with that too.[1][4][6]
